name: candor-vscode
description: Every function's side-effect map, where the code is — CodeLens (effects + blast radius), your architecture policy enforced live as diagnostics, and effect-provenance hover, from candor's per-function effect analysis (JVM bytecode, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, Swift).

candor.policyPath.markdownDescription: Override the architecture policy the diagnostics enforce (exported as `CANDOR_POLICY` to the server). Absolute, or relative to the first workspace folder. Empty = the server discovers the checked-in `.candor/config` policy (spec §3.4).

candor.trace.server.description: Trace the LSP traffic between VS Code and the candor language server.

scripts.build: npm run stage-server && npm run verify-server && esbuild src/extension.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=dist/extension.cjs
